description: This file contains functions for parsing JSON strings while preserving unsafe integer literals, including utility functions for handling numeric tokens and string quoting.

methods.name: isAsciiDigit
methods.description: Checks if a character is an ASCII digit between '0' and '9'.

methods.name: parseJsonNumberToken
methods.description: Parses a numeric token from a JSON string starting at a given index, returning the token, end position, and whether it's an integer.

methods.name: isUnsafeIntegerLiteral
methods.description: Determines if a numeric token exceeds JavaScript's MAX_SAFE_INTEGER, indicating it is unsafe.

methods.name: quoteUnsafeIntegerLiterals
methods.description: Replaces unsafe integer literals in a JSON string with quoted versions to preserve their value.

methods.name: parseJsonPreservingUnsafeIntegers
methods.description: Parses a JSON string into an object, quoting unsafe integers to preserve their precision.

methods.name: parseJsonObjectPreservingUnsafeIntegers
methods.description: Converts a value into a JSON object, parsing and quoting unsafe integers if the input is a string.
